verdict.rationale: Persona publishes a structured API reference with per-resource pages, such as verifications. It also offers a free sandbox environment and Simulate Actions for testing API calls without real verifications or charges. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive or has in-page runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/API explorer in the reference, runnable code samples, request/response examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
